counterfactual_missing_items: normal adrenal glands on CT abdomen
normal filling pressures and no coronary artery disease on cardiac catheterization
decisive_items: 1.9 cm × 2.8 cm contrast-enhancing mass in bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy
isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
response.rationale: R1 correctly identifies the catecholamine-secreting tumor, but C1 is the same entity with the anatomy-defining bladder wall mass, making it the more complete and precise diagnosis. The raw span showing a contrast-enhancing bladder wall mass, combined with micturition-triggered symptoms and isolated normetanephrine elevation, confirms an extra-adrenal paraganglioma of the bladder.

rejected.why: Accurate but less complete; it omits the bladder wall location that is directly supported by the contrast-enhancing bladder mass and micturition-related symptomatology.
